repository.description: Canonical path of the routed repository.

adapter.description: How the Orbit adapter obtained task text and search hits.

workspace.description: Workspace the request named, or null.

task_text.description: Source of the ranked text, such as request_query or orbit.task.show_public_observation.

hybrid_search.description: Source of task-similarity hits, such as local_lexical or orbit.search_hybrid.

warnings.description: Degradations the adapter applied, such as a lexical fallback after an orbit.search failure.

result.description: Ranked recommendations with their evidence and freshness.

input.description: Echo of the intent: the query or the task id.

variant.description: Ranking strategy applied; the plugin always uses the combined variant.

resolved_target_revision.description: Full commit id the recommendations were resolved against.

effective_cutoff.description: Explicit cutoff, or the request observation time when none was sent.

source_freshness.description: Freshness of the history evidence relative to the target revision.

structure_applied.description: Whether code-graph structural evidence contributed to the ranking.

fallbacks.description: Evidence limitations and fallbacks applied to this response, each with a kind and an actionable reason. Structure kinds under Orbit: structure_index_missing (run graph_sync), structure_index_incompatible (run graph_sync with full: true), structure_index_stale (index built at another revision; run graph_sync), structure_unavailable_for_revision (target is not the checkout), structure_unavailable (no usable structural neighbors).

recommendations.description: Ranked destinations with scores, reasons, and supporting task and delivery ids.
